label: Central path, OBR long-term triple lock uprating from April 2032 (March 2026 determinants)
source: The central path, except that from April 2032 the triple lock pays the 'Triple lock' row of the OBR Long-term economic determinants, March 2026 EFO (dated 28 May 2026); before then both rules pay the central path's rates (April 2027 on published inputs, then the OBR's October 2026 outlook)

employment_income.follows: calendar earnings growth the same year (unweighted total)

model_statutory_inputs.follows: the path's September CPI and May-July earnings

model_triple_lock.follows: max(May-July earnings, September CPI, 2.5%) the year before, each input to 0.1 point as the model rounds it
